headline: Countdown to the TIF: Who Will See Tax Relief and Support - Main Goals and the Government Plan
summary: Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis will announce from the TIF stage the main axes of economic policy, including tax relief, for the coming months until the 2027 elections.
why: Tax and fiscal policy announcements shape household incomes, public finances and the outlook for Greek assets ahead of elections.
